fact: Décret n° 2023-51 of 23 February 2023, issued with law n° 36-2018 on official statistics cited as its basis, fixes the RGPH-5 enumeration launch for 25 April 2023, makes statistical secrecy and the duty to answer binding.
title: Journal officiel de la République du Congo n° 10-2023 – Décret n° 2023-51
